stem: Based on the information in paragraphs 4 and 5, what can the reader conclude about the countries that have signed the Antarctic Treaty since 1959?

options.label: A
options.text: They have promised to invest in the economic development of Antarctica.

options.label: B
options.text: They have made a commitment to preserve Antarctica and its natural resources.

options.label: C
options.text: They have decided to focus their efforts only on protecting marine life.

options.label: D
options.text: They agree that tourism in and around Antarctica should be carefully regulated.
